title: Kissed Velvety Moroccan Potatoes Khlea
description: Earthy and velvety Moroccan dish featuring baby new potatoes and lardons, perfect for a post-workout meal. This gluten-free friendly recipe is made in the form of khlea.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, render the lardons over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the skillet and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the olive oil to the skillet and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the smoked paprika and cumin to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the halved potatoes to the skillet, tossing to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the potatoes to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the chicken broth, salt, and black pepper.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and pour the chicken broth mixture over the top.
Return the potatoes to the oven and roast for an additional 15 minutes, or until tender.
Stir in the rendered lardons and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
